title: Disposal of Toyota Qualis
bodyHtml:
TENDER NOTICE

File No. IPC/1091/2017-18
 INDIAN PHARMACOPOEIA COMMISSION
 Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
 Sector-23, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad- 201002.

Dated: 21.07.2017

Sub.: Disposal of Toyota Qualis- reg.

Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) an Autonomous Institution of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India invites sealed tenders for disposal of the Toyota Qualis “AS IS WHERE IS” basis.

S. No.

Registered Number of Vehicle

Model

Make

1

UP-14-N7356

Toyota “QUALIS”

2001
  1. Firms/persons interested in the purchase of the above mentioned vehicle may inspect the vehicle on any working day up to 04.08.2017 between 10:00 AM and 5:00 pm at IPC campus, Sector -23, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad.
  2. The sealed tenders with your highest quoted price for Toyota Qualis in Indian rupees only may be submitted in Performa prescribed in this tender document. Tenders may be submitted to the undersigned along with Demand Draft/Pay Order of Rs. 9,000/- (Rupees Nine Thousand Only) as EMD in favour of “Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Ghaziabad” which is refundable.
  3. Tender received without Demand Draft towards Earnest Money will not be considered and shall not be accepted.
  4. The tender addressed to the “Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission” in a sealed envelope should reach this Department latest by 3:00 pm on or before 07.08.2017. Tender received on or before 3:00 pm on 07.08.2017 and accompanied with the EMD amount of Rs. 9,000/- shall be opened on the same day i.e. 07.08.2017 at 4:00 pm. Tender should be dropped in the Tender box kept in the Guard Room of Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Sector-23, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad. The bidder or his/her authorized representative (not more than one) may witness the Tender Opening.
  5. The sale against this enquiry shall be governed by the Terms & Conditions set out in Annexure-I to this invitation.
  6. Tender document can be obtained personally from this office i.e. IPC, Ghaziabad or download from the Department website: http://www.ipc.gov.in. (opens in a new tab)

(Manish Jain)

Administrative Officer

For Secretary-cum-Scientific Director.
